actionableBlockers.finding: The preflight hashes only listed generated files and COPIES rows. A newly added file in either live canonical or staged generated tree is not rejected before six whole-directory renames. That file would silently disappear from the live tree or be installed without a named-path guard. Current read-only enumeration finds zero extra or missing paths in all six trees, but the installer must repeat exact path-set equality immediately before renaming.
actionableBlockers.requiredFix: Enumerate regular files in each canonical and staged scope, reject symlinks/junctions and compare complete path sets and hashes with PLAN_V4 generated.canonical/source plus the four preserved LICENSE staged postimages before stopping or renaming. Abort on any extra, missing or changed path.

actionableBlockers.finding: Preview stop, listener assertion and local D1/DO state copies run before the try/catch that records failure and restores Website source. An exception there leaves the preview stopped without INSTALLATION_FAILED.json or a defined restart/handoff path. The two write-once pre-stop receipts also make an uncorrected retry fail.
actionableBlockers.requiredFix: Move post-stop assertions and private-state capture inside a transaction-level error handler. Write a failure receipt and define the exact scoped preview restart/recovery action for an abort before source changes; make pre-stop receipts retry-safe only after explicit exact-state review.

actionableBlockers.finding: The stop command permits any workerd.exe child under the website node_modules prefix; it does not pin the observed workerd PID 9356. The current child is PID 9356 with the expected executable, but a replacement or additional matching child could be stopped without a fresh exact-child decision.
actionableBlockers.requiredFix: Require the exact current child set or an explicitly refreshed preview child inventory, including PID 9356 and executable/command line, immediately before Stop-Process.
